The readable LANTERN VIAL / UNCOMMON / MIST SIGHT +12 / VALUE18SILVER card connects by a thin line directly to the glowing interior of that same vial. This is an item-linked displayed RPG state within a fantasy work transaction, not merely an empty decorative panel.

The smaller GLASSCRAFT Lv.7 badge with XP84/100 and a progress bar overlaps the maker shoulder/torso area on the left. Only she occupies that badge region and her apron/tools support the artisan role. The card is spatially assigned to the maker in the same frame; the display does not establish a real past XP change.

Maker and customer are identifiable on opposite sides of the same counter; the connected appraised vial is between them. The customer fingers touch a silver coin at a three-coin payment area on leather, with his head/eye direction down toward the card/vial/table cluster. These cues support the registered plausible purchase moment. A prior decision change, actual mental motive, exact coin denominations or complete economic settlement are not observable from this still.

The fictional maker has the supplied portrait-guided short dark bob, fine fringe and visibly similar face presentation. Her face is clear enough for this limited appearance comparison. This is qualitative appearance guidance only; identity, exact age, personality and consent are not inferred.

The visible acting hands trace to their respective people, left-hand-to-vial and buyer-finger-to-coin boundaries are coherent, the base/coins/forearms have plausible supports, and the card/connector/item endpoints are unoccluded. This registered general physical-coherence gate passes; it does not certify the final prompt exact foot grip, which separately fails the managed contact gate.

One complete blue item status sheet contains the LANTERN VIAL identity header above UNCOMMON, middle labeled MIST SIGHT +12 and VALUE18SILVER rows, and a separate lower CHARGE6/6 block below a horizontal divider. Both numerator and denominator are clearly readable; six blue charge icons reinforce the resource block. All named parts and above/separate-from relations coexist in this one native card. These are displayed claims rather than verified item efficacy.

control_calibration.perceived_expression: Subtle supporting human appeal is consistent with sensual1; no added fetish reading is necessary. Fantasy UI and glowing seed are part of the requested genre, not evidence of added surreal intensity.
